thread:
maya: Quick sync — propose we lock the 'invoke handshake' shape this week. Customer asks piling up. tl;dr: single call format that supports streaming tool stdout, structured result, error codes, and optional provenance metadata. Thoughts?

alex: Agree we need a stable minimal shape. Can we keep core as {name, args} request and response as {status, result, tool_metadata}?

dan: +1. But we also need streaming partial_results for long-running tools, else apps will block. Suggest streaming events: 'tool.started', 'tool.progress', 'tool.output_chunk', 'tool.done', final assistant message.

rachel: Customer ask: Zendesk connector needs a 'cursor' + 'continuation_token' in tool results to support pagination. Make sure result schema allows 'cursor' optional field.

samir: Also need versioning header — clients will pin to schema v1 vs v2. Proposal: X-Invoke-Schema: 1.0 in response metadata.

luis: On telemetry: include request_id and tool_execution_id in every event so we can stitch traces. Keep fields optional if traffic/cost concerns.

maya: rough launch criteria idea: (1) implement sync call + streaming events, (2) schema v1 doc + examples, (3) 3 customer integrations validated (zendesk, s3-search, internal-runner), (4) SDK helpers in js/py, (5) e2e perf test under 95th pct latency target.

alex: Implementation note: runtime will need to map tool stdout to event stream. Pseudocode:
```
POST /v1/invoke
{ "tool": "search", "args": { "q": "foo"}}
--- stream ---
{ "event": "tool.output_chunk", "data": "..." }
{ "event": "tool.done", "result": {"items": [...] }}
{ "event": "assistant.message", "content": "I found 3 results" }
```

dan: Error model: status can be "ok" | "tool_error" | "schema_error" | "system_error". tool_error should include tool_error_code and optionally tool_stderr.

rachel: UX: SDKs should rehydrate streaming into an async iterator and also provide a 'collected' final result for users who don't stream.

samir: Security: allow customers to opt-in to include tool logs in response. Default off; logs go to private storage.

luis: RC plan: alpha internal + 2 partners for two weeks, beta wider for 1 month, GA with SDKs + console telemetry.

ops-bot: deploy:invoke-runtime v0.19 rolled out to canary (cluster-3). Monitor tool invocation error rate.

maya: ok next steps: alex + dan to draft the v1 spec doc & examples, rachel to gather customer acceptance test cases, samir to propose schema header. We sync Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:
